scripts.validate: cd packages/steward_cli && dart pub get && dart run :steward validate
scripts.validate:json: cd packages/steward_cli && dart pub get && dart run :steward validate --json
scripts.eval: cd packages/steward_cli && dart pub get && dart run :steward eval
scripts.eval:json: cd packages/steward_cli && dart pub get && dart run :steward eval --json
scripts.eval:skill: cd packages/steward_cli && dart pub get && dart run :steward eval --skill
scripts.list: cd packages/steward_cli && dart pub get && dart run :steward list
scripts.steward:analyze: cd packages/steward_cli && dart pub get && dart analyze --fatal-infos
scripts.steward:test: cd packages/steward_cli && dart pub get && dart test
